Concatenate Multiple Single-Locus Alignments into a Multi-Locus Alignment

concatenate_alignment.Rd

Reads single-locus FASTA alignments, optionally applies metadata filtering via exclude_by_meta(), maps accession/sequence identifiers to organism labels using sequence.map, filters taxa by locus availability, writes the concatenated alignment and per-locus subsets, and returns summary metadata.

Usage

concatenate_alignment(
  fasta_path,
  names.alignments,
  sequence.map,
  identifier,
  accs_col,
  include_strategy = "all",
  include_strategy_loci,
  include_by,
  output_folder,
  run_name = NULL,
  exclude_options = NULL
)

Arguments

fasta_path

Character vector. Paths to single-locus FASTA alignment files in concatenation order.

names.alignments

Character vector. Locus names matching fasta_path in length and order.

sequence.map

A data.frame mapping sequence/accession IDs to organism identifiers.

identifier

Character. Column name in sequence.map providing the organism/taxon label.

accs_col

Character vector. Column names in sequence.map (one per locus) holding accession numbers or sequence names to match against FASTA headers.

include_strategy

Character. Taxon inclusion rule across include_strategy_loci: "all" (default) or "any".

include_strategy_loci

Character vector. Locus names checked under include_strategy.

include_by

Argument accepted in signature (currently unused in function body).

output_folder

Character. Directory for output alignment files.

run_name

Character or NULL. Optional suffix used in output filename (concat_<run_name>.nexus).

exclude_options

List or NULL. Argument list (excluding aln) passed to exclude_by_meta(), or a list of argument lists for sequential filtering steps. Default is NULL.

Value

A named list containing:

alignment

The concatenated DNAbin alignment matrix.

concat_fasta_path

Path to the written concatenated alignment file.

loci_fasta_path

Character vector of paths to per-locus re-extracted FASTA files.

taxa

Character vector of included taxon labels.

loci_parition

A data.frame of locus name and length.

sequence_composition

A data.frame indicating per-locus sequence presence for included taxa.

See also

exclude_by_meta(), split_concat_alignment()
